mapper.select: SELECT * FROM runrun_v2.courier_certifications WHERE courier_id = #{courierId,jdbcType=BIGINT} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE runrun_v2.courier_certifications SET status = 'PENDING', rejection_reason = NULL, submitted_at = now(), version = version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE courier_id = #{courierId,jdbcType=BIGINT}

UPDATE runrun_v2.courier_certifications SET submitted_photo_resource_id = #{resourceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, submitted_photo_storage_key = #{storageKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, version = version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{certificationId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND version = #{expectedVersion,jdbcType=BIGINT}

UPDATE runrun_v2.courier_certifications SET status = 'APPROVED', eligible = TRUE, approved_photo_resource_id = submitted_photo_resource_id, approved_photo_storage_key = submitted_photo_storage_key, approved_photo_at = now(), submitted_photo_resource_id = NULL, submitted_photo_storage_key = NULL, reviewed_at = now(), version = version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{certificationId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND version = #{expectedVersion,jdbcType=BIGINT}

UPDATE runrun_v2.courier_certifications SET status = 'REJECTED', rejection_reason = #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, reviewed_at = now(), version = version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{certificationId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND version = #{expectedVersion,jdbcType=BIGINT}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO runrun_v2.admin_audit_logs ( administrator_id, action, target_type, target_id, request_id, reason, metadata ) VALUES ( #{administratorId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, 'COURIER_CERTIFICATION_PHOTO_READ', 'COURIER_CERTIFICATION', #{certificationId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{requestId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, jsonb_build_object('photoResourceId', #{resourceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ) ON CONFLICT ( administrator_id, action, request_id ) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM runrun_v2.app_users u JOIN runrun_v2.courier_certifications c ON c.courier_id = u.id WHERE u.role = 'COURIER' AND (CAST(#{statusFilter,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS text) IS NULL OR c.status = #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND (CAST(#{phoneFilter,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS text) IS NULL OR u.phone ILIKE #{phonePattern,jdbcType=VARCHAR})

SELECT u.id AS "courierId", u.phone, u.created_at AS "registeredAt", c.id AS "certificationId", c.status, c.version, c.submitted_at AS "submittedAt", c.reviewed_at AS "reviewedAt", c.rejection_reason AS "rejectionReason", c.submitted_photo_resource_id, c.approved_photo_resource_id FROM runrun_v2.app_users u JOIN runrun_v2.courier_certifications c ON c.courier_id = u.id WHERE u.role = 'COURIER' AND (CAST(#{statusFilter,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS text) IS NULL OR c.status = #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND (CAST(#{phoneFilter,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS text) IS NULL OR u.phone ILIKE #{phonePattern,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ORDER BY u.id LIMIT #{limit,jdbcType=INTEGER} OFFSET #{offset,jdbcType=BIGINT}
SELECT count(*) FROM runrun_v2.fulfillment_tasks t JOIN runrun_v2.v2_orders o ON o.id = t.order_id WHERE t.courier_id = #{courierId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND t.status = 'DELIVERED'

SELECT count(*) FILTER ( WHERE t.delivered_at >= current_date) today, count(*) FILTER ( WHERE t.delivered_at >= current_date - interval '7 days') week, count(*) FILTER ( WHERE t.delivered_at >= date_trunc('month', now())) AS month_count, count(*) total, count(*) FILTER ( WHERE o.service_type = 'PACKAGE_SMALL') small, count(*) FILTER ( WHERE o.service_type = 'PACKAGE_MEDIUM') medium, count(*) FILTER ( WHERE o.service_type = 'PACKAGE_MEDIUM_LARGE') mediumLarge, count(*) FILTER ( WHERE o.service_type = 'PACKAGE_LARGE') large, count(*) FILTER ( WHERE o.service_type = 'PACKAGE_EXTRA_LARGE') extraLarge, count(*) FILTER ( WHERE o.service_type = 'PACKAGE_XL') xl FROM runrun_v2.fulfillment_tasks t JOIN runrun_v2.v2_orders o ON o.id = t.order_id WHERE t.courier_id = #{courierId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND t.status = 'DELIVERED'

SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.status, o.service_type, o.effective_fee_cents fee_cents, t.delivered_at FROM runrun_v2.fulfillment_tasks t JOIN runrun_v2.v2_orders o ON o.id = t.order_id WHERE t.courier_id = #{courierId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND t.status = 'DELIVERED' ORDER BY t.delivered_at DESC LIMIT #{limit,jdbcType=INTEGER} OFFSET #{offset,jdbcType=BIGINT}
